
{{alias}}( z, n )
    Rounds each component of a single-precision complex floating-point number
    to the nearest multiple of `10^n` toward negative infinity.

    When operating on floating-point numbers in bases other than `2`, rounding
    to specified digits can be inexact.

    Parameters
    ----------
    z: Complex64
        Complex number.

    n: integer
        Integer power of 10.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Complex64
        Result.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( new {{alias:@stdlib/complex/float32/ctor}}( 55.5, -33.3 ), 1 )
    <Complex64>[ 50.0, -40.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
